title: West Bengal State Electricity Board v Dilip Kumar Ray

content.caseIdentity: West Bengal State Electricity Board v Dilip Kumar Ray, (2007) 14 SCC 568
content.facts: Favourable termination alone is insufficient; the other ingredients must be independently proved.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: Favourable termination alone is insufficient; the other ingredients must be independently proved.
content.holding: Favourable termination alone is insufficient; the other ingredients must be independently proved.
content.relevance: Use the case for its stated ratio and apply it to the proved facts.
